 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RUDRA PRAKASH  MISHRA  ORAL ORDER 2 13-03-2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the complainant and learned APP for the State.
2. Petitioner seeks bail in connection with Complaint Case No. 385 of 2019 for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the informant submit that they want to amicably resolve the matter through mediation.
4.
The matter is referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Reconciliation Centre and the Mediation Centre will submit a report in this regard.

entities.text: Patna High Court Mediation and Reconciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. Without going into the merits of the case, let the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.16728 of 2024(2) dt.13-03-2024 petitioner be released on provisional bail for a period of six months on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Court below/concerned Court in connection with Complaint Case No. 385 of 2019 (T.R. No. 1892 of 2023).

6. List this case on 13.09.2024.
